meta.notes: ComfyUI port of the Diffusers path. Sampling runs in the AI4ArtsEdDenoisingArchaeology custom node, so SD3.5 is loaded under ComfyUI's memory management instead of diffusers' enable_model_cpu_offload(). Step frames are decoded after sampling, not inside the step callback, so the VAE and the MMDiT are never GPU-resident at the same time. Written as the probe for whether SD3.5-Large runs on 24/32 GB cards; since 2026-09-18 the resolver answers Large on every card (docs/DEVELOPMENT_DECISIONS.md).
